_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: appoint_room_coordinator (BI-F63200A8). Conformance refuses to execute a Workroom without exactly one explicit Process Overseer, and no tool could set that role: persistWorkroomParticipantAssignment had zero callers and invite_room_participant admits a participant without ever making them coordinator. A live room woke 291 times and refused every one for want of an owner. This earns a permanent place because ownership is a standing property of every room on every install, not a one-off repair — and because the tool is deliberately callable without an acting coworker, so a stalled room can be given an owner by whoever notices it.

registry.packFiles.reason: New statutory-rate-pack.ts (BI-8E1FD1BD): the two tools a research coworker needs to deliver a cited statutory figure — list_statutory_rate_gaps and propose_statutory_rate. They belong in no existing pack, and the alternative was the status quo: coworkers holding web_search that could research a tax rate and had nowhere to record it, so the finding died in a backlog item. Deliberately no ratify tool — confirming a figure is a human action on the finance surface, and a pack that could ratify would defeat the propose/ratify split. Sits alongside federation-membership-pack (main, 2026-09-05) which took this metric to 100.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Promotes find_coworker into the lean core tier so peer CLIs without client-side ToolSearch (Grok, Codex) can discover the coworker roster to route A2A handoffs — same rationale that keeps principle_decide/wiki_query core. Discovery-only; execution still gates on grants. BI-5FB59BC6.
